children: Stablecoin issuer Tether is teaming up with global Bitcoin mining companies to build AI-based mining automation infrastructure.

On October 24, Tether said on its website that 15 companies will take part in its open-source Mining Development Kit, or MDK, a framework aimed at improving interoperability across Bitcoin mining infrastructure.
Participants include major mining hardware manufacturers such as Bitmain, Bitdeer, Canaan and MicroBT, as well as mining pool operators including Foundry Digital, F2Pool and Luxor.
Tether plans to use MDK to expand AI-based mining automation. The goal is to enable AI agents to monitor mining equipment in real time, detect problems and optimize performance.

title: Tether Enlists 15 Companies Including Bitmain for AI-Driven Bitcoin Mining Automation Infrastructure
